title: Outpaint fills a big extension in steps, grows in the direction asked, and can run on Klein
description: Fabio, 2026-09-24, live test of MPI-891: asked the agent to 'expand this image up' (i2i_005, 1280x800) to add text at the top for an Instagram post. The agent sent Outpaint at 4:5 and it failed twice over. (1) NO DIRECTION: js/shell/agentDispatch.js frameRectForRatio always CENTRES the source, so 8:5 -> 4:5 grows top AND bottom evenly; the agent has no way to say 'grow upward' (anchor the source to the bottom). (2) TOO MUCH IN ONE PASS: the fill was ~50% of the frame; one Outpaint pass only holds ~25%. Fabio did it by hand in two passes: Free frame grown ~25% up, then a second pass to 4:5 (screenshots in the MPI-891 thread). Scope, his words: 'open up a card to automate this flow for situations like this, so that the agent wouldn't have to do what I just did in different steps.' The Flow itself should: (a) when the area to fill is over ~25%, work it out and fill it step by step on its own; (b) offer another model (Klein) that does the same job faster. Plus the agent half: a direction/anchor on the frame so 'expand up' grows only the top. Not in scope: Flows landing in the gallery (confirmed fine, 2026-09-24).

attention.reason: Fabio verified live 2026-09-24: no seam, original unchanged
